title: Find it on the street
communication_goal: El estudiante puede dar y entender indicaciones sencillas usando puntos de referencia.
situation: Ayudar a un visitante a encontrar una farmacia, un banco y una estación.
language_focus: The bank is between the café and the pharmacy.
The station is across from the hotel.
The bus stop is at the corner.
The pharmacy is opposite the bank.

vocabulary.example: The bank is between the café and the pharmacy.
The station is across from the hotel.
The pharmacy is opposite the bank.
The bus stop is at the corner.
The pharmacy is opposite the bank.

context.before: A tourist asks for directions on a city street.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Where is the pharmacy?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: It is between the café and the pharmacy.

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: The station is across from the hotel, near the corner.

explanation_es: Between coloca algo entre dos referencias. Across from y opposite indican que dos lugares están enfrentados. At the corner ubica algo en una esquina.
spanish_speaker_notes: Between necesita normalmente dos puntos de referencia: between A and B.
Across from y opposite son similares a enfrente de; aprende ambas expresiones para reconocerlas.
No traduzcas at como 'en' automáticamente; at the corner funciona como ubicación puntual.

pronunciation.target: Producir relaciones espaciales con dos referencias y frases de dirección.

models.text: between the café and the pharmacy

pronunciation.student_feedback: Mantén claras las dos referencias de between y la expresión completa across from.

reading.title: A short city walk
reading.text: The visitor starts at the hotel. The station is across from the hotel. The bank is between a café and a pharmacy. The bus stop is at the corner, opposite the station. The visitor finds the pharmacy first.

questions.prompt: What is across from the hotel?

options: Between a café and a pharmacy
questions.answer: Between a café and a pharmacy

activities.instruction: Relaciona cada expresión con la relación del mapa.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Observa cuántas referencias necesita cada expresión.
activities.prompt: Relaciona cada expresión con la relación del mapa.

activities.instruction: Escucha y selecciona dónde está el banco.
activities.prompt: The bank is between the café and the pharmacy.
options: Between the café and the pharmacy
activities.correct_answer: Between the café and the pharmacy
activities.feedback_incorrect: Escucha between y los dos lugares después.

accepted_answers: Between the café and the pharmacy

activities.prompt: The station is ___ from the hotel.
activities.feedback_correct: La expresión es across from the hotel.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Para enfrente de usamos across from.

activities.correct_answer: The bank is between the café and the pharmacy.
activities.feedback_correct: Between conecta correctamente las dos referencias.

accepted_answers: The bank is between the café and the pharmacy.

activities.prompt: The station is between the hotel.
activities.correct_answer: The station is across from the hotel.
activities.feedback_correct: Between necesita dos referencias; aquí la relación es enfrente de.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Usa across from con una referencia; between necesita dos.

accepted_answers: The station is across from the hotel.

activities.instruction: Da dos indicaciones usando dos referencias y un punto de esquina.
activities.prompt: The bank is between the café and the pharmacy. The bus stop is at the corner.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Haz una pausa breve antes de la segunda referencia y enfatiza corner.

activities.instruction: Lee el paseo y traza la ruta del visitante.
activities.feedback_correct: Convertiste las preposiciones en un recorrido.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Relaciona hotel, station, bank, café, pharmacy y corner.
activities.prompt: Lee el paseo y traza la ruta del visitante.

activities.instruction: La IA es turista. Dale una ruta desde un hotel hasta una farmacia y estación.
activities.student_goal: Give directions using between, across from, opposite and at the corner.
activities.feedback_correct: Diste una ruta comprensible con puntos de referencia.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Usa una expresión por relación y nombra siempre el punto de referencia.
activities.prompt: La IA es turista. Dale una ruta desde un hotel hasta una farmacia y estación.

activities.instruction: Describe el camino entre dos lugares conocidos de tu barrio.
activities.prompt: The ____ is between ____ and ____. The ____ is across from ____. The ____ is at the corner.
activities.feedback_correct: Aplicaste preposiciones a tu entorno real.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Dibuja primero el mapa y después convierte cada relación en una frase.
Between necesita dos referencias; across from = enfrente de; at the corner = en la esquina.

mastery_criteria.retry_policy: Los errores se programan para recuperación a 1, 3, 7 y 14 días.
